name: odoo_create_invoice
description: Create a customer invoice in Odoo accounting. Use this when you need to create an invoice for a customer, bill someone for services, or generate a vendor invoice.

lines.description: Invoice lines, each with name, quantity, and price_unit (e.g., [{'name': 'Consulting', 'quantity': 10, 'price_unit': 50}])

invoice_type.description: 'out_invoice' for customer invoice or 'in_invoice' for vendor bill
